paragraphs.text: Hi there! I'm Alex, and I like building things for the web. I'm a software engineer with expertise in crafting accessible, pixel-perfect user interfaces. I take pride in creating thoughtful, inclusive products and have a sharp eye for the little details that separate a good product from an exceptional one.
Currently, I'm a Senior Frontend Engineer at

, where I work on the design system and help build new products. I lead engineering efforts across our component library, partnering closely with designers and engineers to ensure accessibility is built into the foundation of everything we ship.

In the past, I've built products for clients across education, healthcare, and media — and contributed to open-source tooling used by thousands of developers. In my spare time, you can usually find me hiking, playing chess, experimenting with film photography, or exploring new coffee shops.
